exports.label: Copper (refined & blister)
exports.n: Customs data record 0.492 Mt of refined copper from Zambia to Switzerland in 2024 (45.6% of Zambia's recorded exports and 99.2% of Switzerland's recorded imports, CEPII BACI). Switzerland has no coast and is a trading centre for commodities, so the cargo probably ends elsewhere and the customs record only the declared country: a possible reading, not established here. The tonnes stay in the tables and are counted at the passages of the route to its declared destination; no generated route is built from this pair.

exports.warn: This ranks customs trade, not mine supply: countries that refine, trade or vault gold may rank high through re-exports, which the atlas does not measure.
